description: Set up documentation for a new thesis project in an empty folder.
prompt: Use the structured-project-docs skill. Set up the documentation for my bachelor thesis project in this empty folder. It will contain literature notes (about 30 papers), chapter drafts, experiment logs and a bibliography, and I'll work on it with Claude over many sessions. Go ahead without waiting for my confirmation.

assertions.desc: Before creating files, the assistant proposes the tree and says why it fits this project.
PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md has a 'Where does X go?' list.
A CONVENTIONS.md exists and has a 'Skills in use' table.
Every created folder holds real content (no empty folders or near-empty files).
Added Markdown files use kebab-case names (entry files may be upper case).
The reply offers doc-kit's doclint for a project of this size.
